name: Demeter II
legendaryAbilityText:
Double the PRODUCTION value of all of your units.
During your tactical actions, you may double the CAPACITY value of all your units, if you do, skip the 'Production' Step.
flavourText: *A planetary anomaly of living tissue and sentient biomass that continuously consumes its own surface. In ancient records, Demeter II was named for harvest and fertility. That harvest, however, was never meant for crops.*
